summary: Iter-1 cold codegen for chemical_detector (run-5, condition B). Two controllers (GasAnalysisController, MovementController) with mode-nested if-else state machines, inter-controller turn/stop/resume events via SignalPort, Vehicle actuation surface, ChemSensorService analysis functions, Clock-based stuck detection. 17 Java files.

issues.title: No Final state in either controller
issues.detail: The spec routes GasDetected -> j1 (final, GA) and Found -> j1 (final, MV). Per CLAUDE.md, the theory-generated (primary) controller must not contain a Final mode, so both terminal transitions are rerouted to live states while still emitting the terminating events: GA's GasDetected -> Reading with send stop; MV's Found self-loops on stop/turn/resume. Flag is still emitted exactly once per entry into Found from outside.

issues.title: Complementary p/!p guards instead of enum-pair guards
issues.detail: Analysis uses guards stsIsNoGas / !stsIsNoGas (spec says sts==noGas / sts==gasD) and GasDetected uses insAtOrAboveThr / !insAtOrAboveThr (spec: goreq(ins,thr) / NOT goreq). Equivalent on the 2-valued Status enum; chosen so the autonomous-only modes have a propositionally complete total guard cover (Isabelle deadlock_free closes without needing Status exhaustiveness).

issues.title: goreq not used as a model-level guard function
issues.detail: The M2M infers single-parameter function signatures only; the 2-arg goreq in a guard would render with wrong arity. The threshold guard is inlined as ins >= thr; goreq exists in ChemSensorService (used by intensity()) and traces to CD-Fn4.

issues.title: Odometer modelled as a Sensors variable, not an event
issues.detail: CD-Evt3 specifies an odometer event consumed into d0/d1 inside entry actions/transition actions. The generated RoboChart action language has no input-communication statement, so d0/d1 are assigned from vehicle.odometer() (a zero-arg sensor read lifted into the Sensors interface).

issues.title: Entry actions encoded on incoming transitions
issues.detail: Spec entry actions (Analysis: sts=analysis(gs); GasDetected: ins=intensity(gs); Going/TryingAgain: move(lv,a); Avoiding: d0/changeDirection/wait; GettingOut: shortRandomWalk/wait; Found: flag/move(0,Front)) are placed on every incoming transition; the M2T lifts identical incoming actions into state entry actions. Waiting's during randomWalk() is a top-of-mode statement, extracted as entry.

issues.title: Constant values
issues.detail: THR=1.0, LV=1.0, EVADE_TIME=1, STUCK_PERIOD=1, STUCK_DIST=0.0, OUT_PERIOD=1. Spec says values are configured at startup but gives none; values chosen inside the {0..1} FDR type ranges so threshold guards can be both true and false.

issues.title: Chem enum with two literals and sensing-direction mapping
issues.detail: Chem is an opaque equality-only type; encoded as enum {chemA, chemB} for a finite CSP type. angle(index) maps 1->Front, 2->Left, 3->Right, otherwise Back (spec does not fix the mapping).

issues.title: analysis() classification rule
issues.detail: A reading indicates the target chemical iff some element has c == targetChem and i > 0. The spec does not define the classifier precisely.

issues.title: Found re-entry may re-emit flag
issues.detail: Because GA no longer terminates, it can emit stop/turn/resume after MV reached Found; those self-loops re-enter Found and (after entry lifting) re-fire the flag entry action in the model. The single-signal property holds in the Java (flag is idempotent) but not structurally in the model.

next_step: Run the deterministic pipeline (compile .. vacuity) and iterate on feedback.
